methodologyNotes: Ten models independently re-verified against official manufacturer pages (nordictrack.com, onepeloton.com, soletreadmills.com/solefitnessstore.com, horizonfitness.com, bowflex.com, echelonfit.com, proform.com), major retailers (wellbots.com, johnsonfitness.com, abt.com, rcwilley.com, lowes.com, academy.com), and independent reviews (barbend.com, treadmillreviewguru.com, treadmillreviews.net, garagegymreviews.com). priceUsd = US MSRP / published list price as of access date; observed sale prices noted in priceNote. Motor HP = manufacturer-published CHP where disclosed (Bowflex Treadmill 10 does not publish this, kept null). folding is boolean (true = SpaceSaver/Auto-Fold/equivalent). touchscreen_in is null for LCD/LED-readout consoles that are not touchscreens. Corrections this pass: ProForm Carbon Pro 9000 min_incline_pct -3→0 (the current Carbon Pro 9000 has NO decline; the -3% decline belonged to the prior 'Pro 9000' generation, per treadmillreviewguru and proform.com), and Carbon Pro 9000 priceUsd 1799→1999 (the official MSRP is $1,999; $1,799/$1,599 are common sale prices). All other draft values were corroborated. accessedAt 2026-06-15.

products.name: NordicTrack Commercial 1750
products.priceNote: MSRP; iFIT subscription (~$39/mo) separate after 30-day trial
products.provenance: Verified: 4.25 CHP, 12 mph, +12%/-3% incline, 22x60" deck, 16" pivoting touchscreen, 400 lb capacity, $2,499 MSRP. Confirmed by NordicTrack product page and corroborated by TreadmillReviewGuru and Wellbots. The 2025 refresh added Netflix/Spotify streaming and a lifetime motor warranty.

products.name: NordicTrack Commercial 2450
products.priceNote: MSRP; iFIT subscription (~$39/mo) separate after 30-day trial; frequently sold ~$2,499 with $500 promo
products.provenance: Verified current 2025 model (NTL19125): 4.25 CHP, 14 mph max, +12%/-3% incline, 22x60" deck, 24" pivoting HD touchscreen, 400 lb capacity, $2,999 MSRP. Confirmed via NordicTrack page and multiple retailers (Abt, RC Willey, Treadmill Factory). Note: NordicTrack's older FAQ blog cites 300 lb/4.0 CHP, which describes the prior generation (NTL19124); the current NTL19125 is 400 lb/4.25 CHP. Distinguishes from the 1750 by higher top speed and larger display.

products.name: Peloton Tread
products.priceNote: MSRP; Peloton All-Access Membership (~$44/mo) required for live/on-demand classes; machine operable at reduced functionality without subscription
products.provenance: Verified on Peloton's official Tread page: $3,295, 21.5" Full HD swivel touchscreen (360deg movement), 12.5 mph max, 12.5% max incline, no decline, 20x59" running area, 300 lb max user weight, non-folding. 3 HP DC motor corroborated by reviews. A conflicting 23.8" screen figure seen in some third-party results was rejected as model confusion; Peloton's own page states 21.5".

products.name: Sole F63
products.provenance: Verified: 3.0 CHP DC motor, 12 mph, 15% incline (15 levels), 20x60" deck, Easy Assist hydraulic folding, 325 lb capacity, $1,299.99. Console is a 6.5" backlit LCD (not a touchscreen) so touchscreen_in = null. Confirmed by Sole store page and BarBend. Entry-level folding model, no subscription required.

products.name: Sole F80
products.priceNote: MSRP ($1,799.99) per soletreadmills.com; no subscription required
products.provenance: Verified: 3.5 CHP motor, 12 mph, 15% motorized incline (15 levels), 22x60" CushionFlex Whisper Deck, easy-assist folding, 350 lb capacity, 10.1" touchscreen, $1,799.99. Confirmed by Sole product page and BarBend. No subscription required to use console apps.

products.name: ProForm Carbon Pro 9000
products.priceNote: MSRP $1,999; frequently discounted to ~$1,599-$1,799 (Lowe's, others); iFIT subscription (~$39/mo) separate after trial
products.provenance: CORRECTED. ProForm's page and TreadmillReviewGuru confirm 3.6 CHP Mach Z motor, 12 mph, 16" HD touchscreen, 20x60" deck, SpaceSaver folding, 350 lb capacity. Two draft errors fixed: (1) min_incline_pct -3 -> 0 — the current Carbon Pro 9000 has 0-12% incline and NO decline; TreadmillReviewGuru explicitly states it 'does not decline like the previous Pro 9000,' so the -3% was carried over from the prior generation. (2) priceUsd 1799 -> 1999 — official MSRP is $1,999; $1,799 is a common Lowe's sale price, moved to priceNote.

products.name: Horizon 7.0 AT
products.priceNote: List price ~$999 (regularly under $1,000); no subscription required
products.provenance: Verified: 3.0 HP motor (500 lb-thrust incline motor), 0.5-12 mph, 0-15% motorized incline, 20x60" deck, FeatherLight hydraulic folding, 325 lb capacity, list ~$999. Console is a 7.25" high-contrast LCD (not a touchscreen) so touchscreen_in = null. Confirmed by Horizon page and BarBend. Budget model, no subscription required.

products.name: Echelon Stride-6
products.priceNote: MSRP $1,999.99; frequently sold at $1,699.99; Echelon Premier membership (~$39.99/mo) optional
products.provenance: Verified on Echelon's official page: DC 2.5 brushless motor, 12.5 mph max, 12.5% incline (12 power levels), 20.5x60" open-front deck, patented Auto-Fold, 300 lb capacity, $1,999.99 MSRP ($1,699.99 sale at access). Console is an LED readout (not a touchscreen); pairs via Bluetooth to the Echelon Fit app, so touchscreen_in = null. Distinct from the touchscreen-equipped Stride-6S ($1,999.99 with 10" screen). The original Stride (2020) is discontinued; Stride-6 is the current base-tier model.

products.name: Bowflex Treadmill 10
products.priceNote: List price $1,999; JRNY membership (~$19.99/mo) optional, free first year
products.provenance: Verified: $1,999, -5% to +15% motorized incline/decline, 22x60" running path with Comfort Tech cushioning, SoftDrop folding, 400 lb capacity, 10" HD touchscreen, 12 mph max. Motor HP not published by Bowflex (review sites infer ~4.0 HP but unconfirmed) so motor_hp = null. Confirmed by Bowflex page and TreadmillReviewGuru.

products.name: NordicTrack EXP 7i
products.priceNote: MSRP; iFIT subscription (~$39/mo) separate after 30-day trial
products.provenance: Verified: 2.6 CHP motor, 10 mph max, 12% incline (no decline), 20x55" SpaceSaver folding deck, 300 lb capacity, 7" HD tilting touchscreen, $1,299 MSRP. Confirmed by BarBend and TreadmillReviews.net. The shorter 55" deck and 10 mph top speed mark this as NordicTrack's entry-level iFIT treadmill.
